reviews.text: Great business they take great care of your dog. With the park nearby, dogs get a proper walk and play time. Great location.

Oh my goodness!  I have a very reactive dog (rescue from Mexico) and I brought her in muzzled (of course) to have her nails clipped.  I can't even get close to her paws without her leaping away from me.  In the space of about 10 minutes they had her in and out - no issues!  They even said she behaved herself (almost no one ever says anything like that about my dog!).  Wonderful place and I will be seeing them again.
Great people who care for our pups. Wouldn't trust anyone else.  Fantastic groomers! Highly recommend ❤️

Such a special place for dogs. You can tell the pups are genuinely loved and cared for like they’re their own. They get so much attention walks, playtime, cuddles and constant supervision. It really feels like the people there consider themselves lucky to spend their days with the dogs.

Kaori always makes our little Charlemagne (Charlie) look beautiful, soft and clean! She has been grooming him since he was a puppy and is always gentle with him. She is one of his favourite people which is saying a lot because many dogs dislike going to get groomed! We will continue to support Kaori in the years and dogs to come.

These one star reviews appear to be associated with a disgruntled ex employee. In our eight years of business, we have not had an issue like this. If there is a specific situation that warrants a one-star rating, we encourage you to provide details and give us a call directly. We don’t discuss internal matters publicly, but our focus will always remain on maintaining a professional environment and providing the highest standard of care for the dogs.

I was a regular of this place, but last time I was very concerned to see my dog had sores on his elbows and crusted urine stains on his inner thighs and back legs. It seems he was kennelled for too long, likely causing him to urinate on himself. When I arrived, he rushed towards me and immediately pulled for the exit like crazy, remaining restless and pulling on his leash the entire way home. Once there, he drank a full bowl of water very eagerly. Considering how expensive this daycare is, I expected much better care and supervision.
Absolutely brilliant doggy daycare. The staff are so lovely! Recommend 100%!
The best doggy day care in the lower mainland. The staff are so attentive and caring, nothing but positive experiences from this daycare. Thanks again guys 👏👏👏 …

I can’t say enough good things about this dog daycare! From the moment we walked in, the staff were friendly, professional, and clearly passionate about dogs. My pup absolutely loves coming here — he’s always wagging his tail at drop-off and comes home happy and tired after a full day of play. The facility is spotless, safe, and filled with fun activities. I really appreciate the regular updates and photos, too — it’s great knowing he’s in such good hands. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring place for their dog. Special thanks to Sarah who always makes us feel looked after.

Baby D's is absolutely amazing! Every pup is treated like family which creates such a loving, safe, and fun environment. My dog always comes home happy, relaxed, and well cared for. Highly recommend to any pet parent looking for peace of mind and a joyful experience for their furry friend!

A beautiful groom for our nervous pup Bailey, being fostered with Standard Poodles in Need.  Kind and gentle care for a very nervous pup who was in dire need of a groom.   Finished result is beyond what we could have hoped for.

My dog has come here since he was a young puppy (this is literally his second home!) and the entire team have been amazing since day 1. We have also used their grooming services which are great as well (especially as they can pick up and drop off at daycare after). Thank you to the Baby D team for treating Paddy like your own, we are so grateful for all the love and care you give him :)
Thank you Cintya!

Excellent groomer in a convenient location. I take my dog to get her nails cut here and even with tip it’s less than $20 and I’m in and out within 10 minutes. My pup is very anxious, but they have a way of soothing her. Can’t say enough good things!
Great grooming service, we wanted to special thank you to Saki for allways giving all her attention to our pup and doing a great job all the time! Thank you very much!

We absolutely love this doggy daycare! My two pomchis have been going once a week, and they always come home happy, tired, and well taken care of. The staff is incredibly friendly and clearly loves each dog as their own. I really appreciate the level of attention and care they give to all the pups, making sure they have a safe and fun environment to play and socialize. The facility is always clean and organized, which is a huge plus. I feel completely at ease knowing my little ones are in such good hands. Highly recommend to any dog parents looking for a trustworthy daycare! BONUS: they post insta stories all day and I love watching them have fun there!!!

We've been taking our feisty pomeranian to Kaori for years and couldn't be happier with her cuts! She is patient, kind and does such a beautiful job cutting and shaping. Can't recommend her enough!! :)
Good cut and wash,very good service!
